main.description: Asks for a new policy for a scope's packages ('dev.zena-lang.scope.policy'). The caller must be an owner of the scope. The registry holds the record, outside the scope's repository, until the scope maintainers record's 'ownerThreshold' of owners have attested it, and 'dev.zena-lang.registry.completeChange' writes it. Its teams must exist, and its defaults must ask no less than its minimums.

scope.description: The scope, by its DID, on this registry.

swapRecord.description: The CID the record must have now; the write fails with 'InvalidSwap' otherwise.

uri.description: Where the new record will be written, which an attestation names.

cid.description: The new record's CID, which an attestation names.

errors.name: InvalidSwap
errors.description: The record's current CID is not 'swapRecord'.

errors.name: TeamNotFound
errors.description: A default team is not a team of its organization.
